LanguageData.CC_GodUndertow_Shun_Text: Since the night {PAWN} said yes to the voice, the animals won't come near {PAWN_objective}: a {BEAST} lying nearby got up when {PAWN_pronoun} came close and walked off without looking back.
LanguageData.CC_GodUndertow_Saw_Shun: {WHO} saw a {BEAST} get up and walk away from {SHUNNED} at {HOME}, as the animals have done since {SHUNNED} said yes to the voice.
LanguageData.CC_GodUndertow_Drift_Text: A darkness came in from the edge of the colony in the night, slowly, as if it knew the way, and stood over {PAWN} until dawn.{LAMPS} {PAWN} says it spoke, and that it was kind.
LanguageData.CC_GodUndertow_Light_Title: The dark stopped at the light
LanguageData.CC_GodUndertow_Light_Text: A darkness came in from the edge of the colony in the night toward {PAWN}, and at the lamplight near {PAWN_objective} it stopped, and waited there until dawn.{LAMPS}
LanguageData.CC_GodUndertow_Lamps: Every lamp it passed burned low.
LanguageData.CC_GodUndertow_Company_Text: A darkness came in from the edge of the colony in the night toward {PAWN}, and stopped a few steps away, where {HOLDER} sat with {PAWN_objective}. It waited there until dawn and came no closer.
LanguageData.CC_GodUndertow_Gone_Text: A darkness drifted in from the edge of the colony in the night toward {PAWN}, and was gone at dawn.
LanguageData.CC_GodUndertow_Why_StoodOver: Afraid since {DATE}: a darkness stood over them all night and spoke to them.
LanguageData.CC_GodUndertow_Saw_Drift: {WHO} lay all night at {HOME} with a darkness standing over them that had come in from the edge, and it spoke to them kindly.
LanguageData.CC_GodUndertow_Saw_Light: A darkness came toward {DESPERATE} at {HOME} in the night and stopped at the edge of the lamplight.
LanguageData.CC_GodUndertow_Saw_Company: {WHO} sat with {DESPERATE} at {HOME} through the night, and a darkness that came toward them stopped a few steps off.
LanguageData.CC_GodUndertow_Ear_Text: {PAWN} stopped in the old ruins and pressed a hand over one ear. {PAWN_pronoun} says it went quiet in there, quieter than quiet, and now and then something on the other side of the quiet says {PAWN_possessive} name.
LanguageData.CC_GodUndertow_Saw_Ear: {HEARER} stood in the old ruins at {HOME} and came away with a hollow ear, hearing a name said from very far down.
